risk one's life: The firefighter decided to risk his life to save a little girl trapped in the burning building.
那位消防員決定冒生命危險，去救一個受困在火場大樓裡的小女孩。
risk failure: Great inventors are willing to risk failure many times before they finally create something useful.
偉大的發明家願意一再冒失敗風險，直到最後創造出有用的東西。
risk everything: Down by two points with three seconds left, the player decided to risk everything on one long shot.
落後兩分、只剩三秒時，那名球員決定孤注一擲，投出一記遠距離三分球。
run the risk of: If you don't wear sunscreen at the beach, you run the risk of getting a bad sunburn.
如果你在海邊不擦防曬乳，就會冒著嚴重曬傷的風險。
at risk: Without clean drinking water, thousands of children in the area are at risk of catching serious diseases.
沒有乾淨的飲用水，該地區數千名兒童正處於感染嚴重疾病的危險中。
risk it: The road looked icy, but we were late for the train, so Dad decided to risk it and kept driving.
路面看起來結了冰，但我們快趕不上火車了，所以爸爸決定冒險一試，繼續往前開。
rival the best: The beef noodles at this small night market stall can rival the best restaurants in Taipei.
這個夜市小攤的牛肉麵足以媲美台北最好的餐廳。
nothing rivals it: Many cities have beautiful night views, but for me Hong Kong is special, and nothing rivals it.
許多城市都有美麗的夜景，但對我來說香港很特別，無與倫比。
rival in beauty: The two sisters rival in beauty, so people in town often argue about which one is prettier.
這對姊妹美貌不相上下，所以鎮上的人常爭論哪一個比較漂亮。
rival each other: The two smartphone companies rival each other by releasing new models with better cameras every year.
這兩家手機公司每年推出相機更好的新機型，互相競爭。
the crowd roared: When the home team scored the winning goal in the last minute, the crowd roared with excitement.
主隊在最後一分鐘踢進致勝球時，群眾興奮地歡呼。
roar with laughter: Everyone in the class began to roar with laughter when the teacher accidentally wore two different shoes.
老師不小心穿了兩隻不同的鞋子，全班同學頓時哄堂大笑。
roar past: Standing at the side of the road, we watched the racing cars roar past at amazing speed.
我們站在路邊，看著賽車以驚人的速度呼嘯而過。
business is roaring: Since the new MRT station opened nearby, business is roaring at the little noodle shop on the corner.
自從附近的新捷運站開通後，街角那家小麵店的生意火爆。
roar in anger: The lion began to roar in anger when another male tried to enter its territory.
當另一頭公獅想闖進牠的地盤時，那頭獅子開始怒吼。
rob a bank: Two men wearing masks tried to rob a bank downtown, but the police caught them within minutes.
兩名戴著面罩的男子企圖搶銀行，但警方在幾分鐘內就逮到了他們。
rob someone of: A serious knee injury could rob him of the chance to play for his country in the Olympics.
嚴重的膝傷可能剝奪他代表國家參加奧運的機會。
rob the cradle: When the sixty-year-old actor married a twenty-five-year-old model, people joked that he liked to rob the cradle.
當那位六十歲的演員娶了一位二十五歲的模特兒時，大家開玩笑說他喜歡老牛吃嫩草。
rock the boat: Most workers were unhappy with the new rules, but nobody wanted to rock the boat by complaining to the boss.
大多數員工對新規定不滿，但沒有人想向老闆抱怨而惹麻煩。
be rocked by scandal: The whole city was rocked by scandal last week when the mayor was suddenly arrested for taking bribes.
上週市長因收賄突然被捕，整座城市被醜聞震撼。
rock the world: When the first smartphone with a touch screen came out, it seemed to rock the world of technology overnight.
第一支觸控螢幕智慧型手機問世時，似乎一夕之間震撼了整個科技世界。
rock a baby: Grandma would gently rock a baby in her arms while singing old Taiwanese songs.
奶奶會一邊唱著老台語歌，一邊在懷裡輕輕搖嬰兒。
rock solid: Our team's defense was rock solid, so the other side could not score a single goal all night.
我們隊的防守堅如磐石，所以對手整晚連一球都踢不進。
rock the foundations: The shocking secret threatened to rock the foundations of trust between the two old friends.
那個驚人的秘密可能動搖這兩位老朋友之間信任的根基。
roll out a product: The company will roll out a product in stores across Asia next spring that can translate speech instantly.
這家公司明年春天將在亞洲各地的商店推出一款能即時翻譯語音的產品。
roll back prices: To win back customers, the supermarket promised to roll back prices on rice, eggs, and milk.
為了贏回顧客，超市承諾將米、蛋和牛奶的價格降回原價。
roll up one's sleeves: There is a lot of cleaning to do after the flood, so let's roll up our sleeves and get started.
淹水過後有很多清理工作要做，所以我們捲起袖子開始幹活吧。
roll with the punches: Life as a new teacher is full of surprises, so you have to learn to roll with the punches.
當新老師的生活充滿意外，所以你必須學會隨機應變。
get the ball rolling: To get the ball rolling, the teacher asked each student to share one idea for the class party.
為了開始行動，老師請每位學生分享一個關於班級派對的點子。
heads will roll: The boss was furious about the mistake and warned that heads will roll if it ever happens again.
老闆對這個錯誤非常憤怒，並警告如果再發生，就有人要倒楣了。
on a roll: Our basketball team is on a roll, having won seven games in a row this season.
我們的籃球隊連連得手，本季已經連贏七場比賽。
